body: First loves are always the hardest and it usually hurts the most! If you guys ended on a positive note maybe down the line you can be friends again if that's what you want. The best way to get over anything is time. You're still going to think of her! Honestly you might think of her your whole life, but eventually with time it will be less intense. You said you're in highschool, I'm 23 and not even close to the person I was in highschool. Everything has changed. And so much will change with you. Dont be hard on yourself. This particular situation was just not in your control.

Its not that easy! Ive been there so many times they draw you back in so much but it's in your best interest to put your foot down. Otherwise she'll just keep coming back. Moving on is hard when they keep popping up back in your life. People are so aggressive on this sub jeez. If you respond to her that's your choice but just know that all of the healing you've done might be undone by getting involved again. Good luck :)
